title: Xuno
tagline: A Web3 AI platform for tracking social media trends and executing DeFi transactions seamlessly.
description:
Xuno bridges the gap between social media analytics and DeFi operations, enabling users to identify crypto trends from influential content creators and act on them within a single intuitive interface. The platform analyzes social data from curated lists of Web3 influencers, extracts mentioned tokens and market sentiments, and provides users with the ability to execute trades directly through integrated DeFi protocols.
Key features include multi-chain token swaps, cross-chain transfers, deep token analytics, and real-time market data. Xuno's AI-powered analysis tools help users identify emerging tokens and trends from social conversations, giving them an edge in the fast-moving crypto market. The platform supports multiple blockchain networks including Ethereum, BNBChain, Polygon, Arbitrum, and more, allowing users to manage assets across their entire Web3 portfolio.
With Xuno, users can go from discovering a trending token on social media to executing a swap or cross-chain transfer within minutes, all through a seamless, modern interface that prioritizes security and user experience.
how_its_made:
Xuno is built on a modern tech stack optimized for performance and user experience. The frontend is developed with Next.js 14 (App Router) and React, styled with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for a polished interface. For state management, we leverage React Hooks and Context APIs to maintain a clean, efficient architecture.
The backend functionality is implemented through Next.js API Routes, which serve as serverless functions when deployed to Vercel. For blockchain interactions, we use ethers.js for high-level Ethereum operations and viem for lower-level blockchain calls, ensuring robust and secure Web3 connectivity.
Integration with DeFi protocols is achieved through the 1inch API for optimized token swaps and custom cross-chain services for bridging assets between networks. We incorporated the Nodit API for comprehensive token information and price discovery across multiple chains.
The user authentication system combines session-based auth with Web3 wallet verification, ensuring secure access while maintaining a smooth user experience. All transactions are signed client-side, with no private keys ever touching our servers.
For data processing and analytics, we built custom NLP algorithms to extract token mentions and sentiment from social media content, providing users with valuable insights. The entire application is deployed on Vercel's edge network, ensuring fast loading times and a responsive experience worldwide.
